name: lessonrail
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE original identity concept for "Lessonrail", staff software for tutoring centers connecting attendance, instructor handoffs, observations and student progress across visits. Name means the continuous support structure connecting learning sessions, not trains. Minimal contemporary software identity, dark graphite #101113, soft white #F2F2ED and small muted periwinkle #9899E8 accent. Exact wordmark "Lessonrail" in impeccably spaced medium-weight contemporary sans, open counters, upright and calm, with subtle custom character in L and rail joins. Original symbol: two short offset parallel rails connected by ONE decisive vertical bridge, forming an unmistakable compact architectural glyph with a stepped negative-space pathway, maximum three simple filled shapes, square-ish footprint, smooth controlled corners. No circle with diagonal cuts, no cursor arrow, no knot, no asterisk, no imitation of existing tech-company logos. Logo must have confident optical balance and readable silhouette at 24px. Primary flat monochrome white mark + wordmark, no gradients or effects. Create a restrained landscape 1536x1024 design review image: upper half generous empty charcoal space around ONE large horizontal icon + name lockup; bottom left smaller actual-size-looking header lockup, bottom right simple website context crop with logo, small navigation Product / Overview and the headline "Keep every learning day connected." No dashboard data. Thin divider only between large logo and secondary uses. All backgrounds truly dark, no cream panels. Mature thoughtful approachable tutoring operations, not childish and not finance/luxury. NO animal, engraving, crest, badge, serif lettering, metallic finish, mockup material, 3D, gradient glow, cartoon, generic graduation cap, lightbulb, book icon, star or swoosh. The flat symbol must be identical in every use. Do not add annotations, invented claims, awards or extra concept names.

name: inlesson
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original identity concept for "Inlesson", a staff workspace for tutoring centers: who is here, what each student is working on, what instructors observed, and what comes next. Name rooted in "in lesson" meaning active engaged learning, not an AI tutor. Different visual solution from rail/path logos: construct a compact abstract lowercase i/l mark as a single thick folded strip with ONE circular dot recessed above its shorter upright, bold vertical stance, an open counter suggesting a student within the learning workspace. At most two flat filled shapes; calm clear strong geometry with subtly human optical rounding. The symbol should read as its own sign, not a pictogram person or school crest. Dark warm-black #151413, chalk white #F0EFEB, small soft apricot #D6A58C accent used for dot only in colored variant. Exact wordmark "inlesson" all lowercase in exceptionally well-spaced humanist sans, sturdy medium weight, single-storey g not relevant, distinctive compact n and open e, no italics. Make an extremely polished flat software brand board landscape 1536x1024. Main composition is a large horizontal pure-white symbol + wordmark on warm-black with abundant negative space. Lower portion show a compact dark header lockup on left and a quiet website navigation/hero crop on right: logo, Product / Overview navigation, headline "A clearer view of every student." All dark panels. Symbol consistent across every usage. A tiny secondary apricot-dot version permitted, otherwise monochrome. Contemporary Bay Area software restraint and high typographic precision without copying Cursor, Linear, Claude, ChatGPT or Apple marks. NO metallic finish, bevel, embossing, gradient, glow, 3D, animal, coat of arms, book, academic cap, lightbulb, stock infinity knot, asterisk, circle with diagonal stripes, cursor arrow or luxury serif. No fictional user records, claims, explanatory labels or extra concepts. This is tutoring coordination software, not whiskey, hardware, security or an AI chatbot.
